page.overview:
Who is Erybotes?

In Greek mythology, Eribotes, son of Teleon, was counted among the Argonauts. Eribotes appears to have had skills of a physician: in the Argonautica, he attends on Oileus when the latter is wounded by a feather of one of the Stymphalian Birds.
